description: This file defines the React component for the upload page of a web application, enabling users to upload CSV files containing energy consumption data. It handles file input, parsing via an imported utility, and displays a preview of parsed data. It also manages routing and user authentication context.

methods.name: UploadInner
methods.description: Main React component managing file upload, parsing, and preview display.

methods.name: handleFile
methods.description: Handles the uploaded file, reads its content, and parses CSV data.
